findings.title: Nothing in the platform reacted to the outage
findings.evidence: target container stayed 'running' and never became 'unhealthy' during the fault; compose `restart: always` only acts on exit, never on health

summary: Pausing `things` (container_pause) moved API success from 100% to 0% across 24 samples; 1 service affected; recovered in 26 s without intervention. The safety monitor aborted early (error_rate).
production_implication: In production most users would see errors for the whole duration of a container_pause on things. Health checks stayed green while the API failed, so no orchestrator or alert would have reacted. The container sat unhealthy with nothing acting on it; Docker's restart policy does not cover this state.
